summary: The global marketing team is executing a search/AI visibility strategy centered on Asia Star and Intelligent China while finalizing the knowledge website redesign, but a widespread Outlook lockout and several overdue action items demand immediate attention this week.
summaryDetail: The top priority is resolving the Outlook account lockout caused by stale saved passwords across devices—every team member must delete and re-login on all devices, and Joseph must confirm backend unlock with JSB. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: Joseph must share the HTML inspiration file, the team needs a half-hour feedback session to mark specific changes, and Joker will then implement the design updates, including dispersing videos by topic and adding the BCI/BSI index banner. The search/AI visibility strategy is ramping up: Joseph must draft the target areas/prompts document and profile Asia Star participants and CRM hot leads, while the team audits Google Ads conversion tracking and launches the Intelligent China webpage to drive traffic. Upcoming items include the UNICON Director's Conference letter (mentioning CEIBS as co-host, May 2028), the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum invitation to Ms. Kanta Singh, and the Dutch entrepreneurs delegation outreach. The Muck Rack renewal is approved and will be paid when Joseph returns from vacation.

decisions.text: Stale saved passwords on multiple devices caused the account lockout; all devices must be updated.
Remove the standalone videos section; videos will be dispersed by topic instead.
Keep the two-menu structure with the school menu at top and knowledge menu centered.
Bring the BCI (and BSI) index banner into the knowledge section, similar to the school homepage.
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage.
Adopt the article detail page improvements (prominent authors, audio, pullout quotes, varied title font sizes).
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China as top two programs; US partner programs on hold initially.
Berkeley program suggested as a possible third priority, to be considered in the audit phase.
Focus initially on outcomes and initial prompts, then expand analysis.
The Global Marcom work report is approved by Julie, Xuan, and Kaylee after Ira's revisions.
